experimental_procedure: To a round bottom flask equipped with magnetic stir bar, L-tyrosine (200 mg, 1.2 mmol) was added and dissolved in DMF (8.0 mL, 0.15 M) followed by the addition of EtN3 (157 mg, 1.56 mmol, 1.3 eq.) and DMAP (7.5 mg, 0.06 mmol, 0.05 eq.). The reaction flask was cooled in ice water for 15 minutes and CbzCl (224 mg, 1.32 mmol, 1.1 eq.) was added drop wise over 5 minutes. The reaction was monitored by TLC and until the starting material was consumed over 5 hours. The mixture was diluted with EtOAc (100 mL) and washed by HCl solution (1.0 M), saturated NaHCO3 (aq.), brine and then dried over anhydrous Na2SO4. The solvent was removed under reduced pressure to give the crude residue. Without column purification, the crude Z-tyrosine was dissolved in DMF (8 mL, 0.15 M) and MeI (186 mg, 1.32 mmol, 1.1 eq.) was added. Next, oven dried K2CO3 (882 mg, 6.0 mmol, 5 eq.) was added to the reaction mixture was stirred for 10 hours, based on TLC consumption of the starting material. The mixture was diluted with EtOAc (100 mL), washed with HCl solution (1.0 M), saturated NaHCO3 (aq.), brine and then dried over anhydrous Na2SO4. The solvent was removed under reduced pressure to give the crude residue. Flash silica gel chromatography (Ethyl Acetate/Hexane 40:60) was then applied to give the protected amino alcohol. 285 mg (75% yield).
